mfn. (-कः-का-कं)
Thine.
E.
कन् added to तव the poss. case of त्वं.

mfn. (-कः-की-कं)
Thine.
E.
तवक, and अण् added.

n. (-रं)
Milk and water.

m. (-जः)
A sort of sugar prepared from a species of Hedysarum.

m. (-षः)
1 Heaven, paradise.
2 The ocean.
f. (-षी)
1 A river.
2 The daughter of

INDRA.
3

Strength, (in the dialect of the Vedas.)
E.
तव a Sautra root, टिषच् Uṇādi affix; also ताविष and तवीष.

Heaven.
2

The ocean.
3 Gold.
E.
see the last.

m. (-षः)
1 Svarga or paradise.
2 The ocean.
f. (-षी)
The daughter of

INDRA.
2

A river.
3 The earth.
E.
तव a Sautra root, Uṇādi affix टिषच्; also read तविष, तवीष, &c.

mfn. (-नः-नी-नं)
Thine.
E.
तवक for तव thine, and खञ् aff.

mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्)
1 So many, as many, as much.
2 All.
ind.
So much, so far, so many, unto, until, the correlative to यावत्.
E.
तत् that, then, and डावत् affix: see यावत्.

mfn. (-कः-का-कं)
Of so much, worth so much, &c. see the next.

mfn. (-त्कः-त्का-त्कं)
Of so much, bought for so much, &c.
E.
कन् added to तावत्; also with इट् inserted तावतिक.

adv. n. (-लं)
For so long a period, for such a time.
E.
तावत्, and काल time.

mfn. (-सः-सी-सं)
Measuring so much.
E.
तावत्, and द्धयसच् aff.

mfn. (-त्रः-त्री-त्रं)
So much.
E.
तावत्, and मात्रच् aff.

n. (-रं)
A bow string.

m. (-रिः)
The constellation Taurus.
